```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
```

<!-- https://stackoverflow.com/a/70891533/190277 -->

```{r}
expSup <- function(x, digits=3) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), NA,
         sprintf(paste0("%05.", digits, "f x 10^%d^"),
                 x/10^floor(log10(abs(x))), floor(log10(abs(x)))))
}

dd <- read_csv("parameters.csv") |>
  filter(type == "param") |>
  select(Symbol, Definition, Value, minval, maxval) |>
  ## mutate(across(c(Value, minval, maxval), expSup)) |>
  mutate(Value = ifelse(is.na(minval), Value,
                        sprintf("%s - %s", minval, maxval))) |>
  select(-c(minval, maxval))

kbl(dd) |>
  column_spec(2, width = "3in")
```
